audience.text: Python developers and data engineers who need to programmatically create, read, and modify Excel .xlsx workbooks without licensing commercial dependencies.

capabilities.text: The Workbook class enables creating new workbooks from scratch or loading existing .xlsx files for editing.
capabilities.title: Create and edit Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Cells support reading and writing values and formulas, with a basic FormulaEvaluator for cells without cached values.
capabilities.title: Cell value and formula handling

capabilities.text: Style objects allow setting fonts, fills, borders, alignment, text wrap/rotation, and number formats on cells.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: DataValidationCollection supports dropdown lists, number ranges, and custom formulas; ConditionalFormatCollection applies rules-based formatting.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: ChartCollection supports 16 chart types; ShapeCollection adds rectangles, ovals, and preset shapes; TableCollection manages structured Excel tables.
capabilities.title: Charts, shapes, and tables

capabilities.text: Workbooks can be exported to CSV, JSON, and Markdown formats using dedicated save methods.
capabilities.title: Export to text-based formats

capabilities.text: Workbooks can be encrypted and decrypted using Agile encryption (ECMA-376 Part 2 §4) via password arguments.
capabilities.title: Password protection and encryption

capabilities.text: AutoFilter supports filtering rows; PageSetup, PageMargins, and page-break collections configure print layout.
capabilities.title: Auto filters and page layout

limitations.text: Only .xlsx is supported for native load/save; CSV, JSON, and Markdown are additional text-format export targets, not general spreadsheet formats.
Only Agile encryption (ECMA-376 Part 2, Section 4) is supported for reading and writing password-protected workbooks; Standard encryption is not yet supported for reading.
FormulaEvaluator is a basic evaluator for cells without cached values and is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in pure Python without requiring Microsoft Excel or Windows.
Provides native support for password-protecting and decrypting Excel workbooks using Agile encryption per ECMA-376.
Supports exporting workbook data to common text-based formats including CSV, JSON, and Markdown.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Python is a free, open-source, pure-Python library for creating, reading, and modifying Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported Excel features beyond those explicitly listed in examples and public symbols is not fully documented.
Whether Standard encryption support is planned for future releases is not stated.
The scope of formula support in the basic FormulaEvaluator is not detailed beyond cells without cached values.

workflows.name: Create and populate a new workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, access its worksheets and cells collection, assign values to cells, and save the result as an .xlsx file.

workflows.name: Read and inspect an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file using Workbook, access worksheet cells, and retrieve cell values for inspection or processing.

workflows.name: Apply styling and formatting
workflows.text: Retrieve a cell's style, modify font properties such as bold, color, and size, then apply the updated style back to the cell.

workflows.name: Add data validation rules
workflows.text: Create a data validation collection on a worksheet, add a list-type validation to a cell range, and save the workbook with the rule applied.

workflows.name: Export to CSV
workflows.text: Load an .xlsx workbook and use save_as_csv to export its data to a CSV file.

workflows.name: Password-protect and decrypt workbooks
workflows.text: Save a workbook with a password argument to encrypt it, and load an encrypted workbook by providing the same password.
